name: status-bar
description: The missing status bar for Claude Code, showing usage: 5h/7d rate limits with reset times, context fill, session cost and the prompt cache timer. Other mods can add segments.

show.title: Show the bar
show.description: Off hides the bar. /status-bar on|off|toggle hides or shows it at runtime.

position.title: Position
position.description: above: the band directly above the prompt. below: under the prompt, after the hint line. status: plain text in the status line under the prompt.

segments.title: Segments
segments.description: The segments to show, in order. Commas separate groups spread over the width; + joins segments in one group. Built-ins: limit5h, limit7d, limitSpend, ctx, legend, cost, cache. Hovering ctx shows its legend; add legend (ctx+legend) to show it beside the meter where there is no mouse. Ids of other mods' segments work too; unknown ids are ignored.

budgetUsd.title: Session budget (USD)
budgetUsd.description: A cost budget of your own for one conversation, in USD. Claude Code gives mods no account budget in dollars (only the spend limit's percentage, which the limitSpend segment shows), so 0 (the default) shows the session cost alone; above 0 the cost segment adds / $budget, a meter and the percentage.

contextLimit.title: Context limit (tokens)
contextLimit.description: A context ceiling of your own, in tokens, e.g. 256000: the ctx segment's window figure, meter and percentage count against it (62k/256k) instead of the model's window. Once the context goes past it, ctx shows the model's window again (320k/1.0M), with the window figure in magenta. A value above the model's window is ignored. 0 (the default) uses the model's window.

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: The prompt cache lifetime the timer counts down from.
